feedback:
Adapted the RP2040 based RAM emulator that was used during development: changed pins and calibrated the delay time for addr_out and data_in pins. Wrote a test program in C++ for the RP2040 to animate the PPU output in real time.
Tried the graphics, haven't tried the synth part yet.
Working:
- Both tile planes, independent scrolling
- Sprites
- Setting PPU registers, changing them for different scan lines using the copper:
	- Palettes
	- Scrolling
	- Sprite lists
- Setting PPU registers: base addresses and display mask
- Double buffered copper lists to avoid flickering

Limitations:
- Only <= 7 sprites per scan line seems to work consistently (8 works sometimes, unclear when)
- With a single row of sprites, seeing problems when putting more than 4 on the same scan line -- workaround should be possible
